## Heimdall — this repo is gated

Heimdall is a watchman wired into git. Gates run from `pre-commit` and `pre-push`,
so every change here is checked whether or not an agent is in the loop.

- `hmd verdict` — the last gate result for this repo, and why.
- `hmd demo` — watch a gated build run end to end.

**A deny blocks the commit.** git exits nonzero and a `BIFRÖST` block prints on
stderr naming what failed. Read the name, fix the code, commit again. `HMD_SKIP=1
git commit …` bypasses the gate but logs an unproven-merge receipt to
`.heimdall/receipts/unproven.log` — visible, never silent.

**Gates are external and falsifiable — satisfying the oracle is the only path.**
The verdict is computed from artifacts on disk, not from your explanation, so you
cannot argue your way past a gate. Rewriting or weakening the test is not a path to
green; it is the exact failure the gate exists to catch.
